title: Architectural Design Synthesis from Client Discovery
business: A mid-sized architectural firm specializing in custom residential builds.
problem: Project architects frequently lose critical design constraints and client preferences discussed during verbal discovery meetings, leading to costly re-designs and misaligned project scopes.
solution: By integrating the Fathom connector with Claude, the firm enables architects to query meeting transcripts directly within the Claude interface, allowing the AI to synthesize specific client requirements into technical project briefs without manual transcription review.
steps: Authorize the Fathom connector within the Claude workspace to establish secure API access to meeting data.
Use the list_meetings tool to identify the specific discovery call associated with a project client.
Invoke get_meeting_transcript to retrieve the raw dialogue for the identified session.
Prompt Claude to extract design constraints and material preferences from the retrieved transcript to generate a structured project requirement document.
outcome: Architects achieve higher accuracy in project documentation and significantly reduce the time spent manually reconciling meeting notes with design software requirements.
limitation: The connector relies on the quality of the original meeting recording; if audio is poor or speakers overlap significantly, the transcript may contain inaccuracies that propagate into the generated project brief, which must be verified against the original audio file.
